result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a residential street with a continuous sidewalk that is in fair condition with visible cracking and weeds. There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian safety features visible, and parked vehicles may obstruct sightlines for those attempting to cross the two-lane roadway.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is a residential intersection lacking basic safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or visible traffic control devices. The existing sidewalk and roadway are in poor condition, featuring significant cracking, vegetation overgrowth, and large puddles that indicate drainage issues and pavement degradation.

hazards.name: Roadway degradation and standing water
hazards.description: A large puddle and broken asphalt in the middle of the intersection create slip hazards and force pedestrians to deviate from their path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center right, where the two streets meet

hazards.name: Lack of crossing infrastructure
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks and curb ramps makes crossing difficult for all users, especially those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

hazards.name: Sidewalk overgrowth and cracking
hazards.description: The sidewalk is poorly maintained with significant weeds and cracks, creating potential tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground along the fence line

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps at all corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Pavement and Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair the broken asphalt and cracked sidewalk to provide a smooth, predictable surface for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Intersection Traffic Control
interventions.description: Evaluate the need for stop signs or other traffic calming measures to manage vehicle speeds at this residential intersection.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with wide asphalt roadways and a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control devices. While sidewalks are present on both sides, the open geometry and lack of infrastructure likely encourage higher vehicle speeds, creating a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, requiring pedestrians to cross wide lanes without designated space or right-of-way protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The wide lanes and lack of traffic calming measures likely encourage vehicle speeds that exceed safe residential limits.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway extending through the center

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Mature trees and vegetation at the corners may obstruct the visibility between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left corners of the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility (continental) crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: Speed Management Measures
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming such as speed humps or raised intersections to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection that lacks fundamental pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic control signage. While sidewalks are present along the residential properties, the wide roadway and lack of designated crossing points create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.
